reviewer: Claude Code nightly (Opus), inspected the sheets after fixing scenes 1,2,7,8,9,10,15,16,18,19,23,24,25

content.notes: Cover: stick figure 'du' holds bread with jam, nest at right, headline BROT NEBEN AMEISEN? matches line 0.

action.notes: Walks in, then raises the bread forward on its palm (fixed: the raised arm no longer crosses the face).

motion.notes: Arm IK continuous; the bread rests on the hand dot; feet on ground while walking.

composition.notes: Headline is readable at the top, figure and nest are separated, subtitle clear.

timing.notes: The bread is lifted at 1.2–1.6 s, before 'Brot mit Marmelade' (1.54).

content.notes: Placing the bread next to the nest, label NEBEN DAS NEST.

action.notes: Crouches, left hand lowers the bread to the ground at 3.96, releases and pulls the hand back.

motion.notes: Fixed: the gripping hand is now at the bread's end outside the torso; contact until release, then the bread stays put.

composition.notes: Nest left, figure right, bread between them; card at the top.

content.notes: Top-down: one ant leaves the nest (line 1, 'gedachten Fall').

action.notes: The ant comes out of the nest and walks in a zigzag toward the bread.

motion.notes: Legs alternate and the faint search path follows behind it; continuous.

composition.notes: Nest at lower left, bread at upper right, the same geography as in later top-down shots.

timing.notes: The ant is clearly moving on 'Ameise' (6.8).

content.notes: Side close-up: the ant finds the bread; card AUF NAHRUNGSSUCHE.

action.notes: Walks up, stops, antennae touch the bread, '!' appears.

motion.notes: Legs on the ground, stops before the bread, no overlap.

composition.notes: Large ant, clear contact point, card in the sky area.

content.notes: Extreme close-up on the jam: the ant checks the food, card PRÜFT.

action.notes: Antennae tap repeatedly.

motion.notes: Body stays still on the jam, antennae alternate.

composition.notes: Simple and readable; the card is above the ant.

content.notes: The ant runs back to the nest (line 2).

action.notes: Leaves the bread, runs along the route and disappears into the nest opening; a ring ripples.

motion.notes: The ant turns toward the nest and is not teleported; the ring only appears once it is inside.

composition.notes: Top-down geography stays the same.

timing.notes: Reaches the nest at about 11.2, on 'Nest' (11.22).

content.notes: A little later more ants come out, card ETWAS SPÄTER (line 3).

action.notes: Ants come out of the nest one after another and follow the route.

motion.notes: Evenly spaced, continuous legs.

composition.notes: Fixed: the card moved to y 190 and no longer covers the bread.

timing.notes: The first ant appears at 12.9, matching 'weitere Ameisen' (12.96).

content.notes: Side view: a row of ants on the same line ('derselben Strecke').

action.notes: The row walks evenly from the nest toward the bread.

motion.notes: Fixed: the ants are larger (s 2.6) and evenly spaced; feet on the ground line; they pass in front of the bread.

composition.notes: Ground-level framing with a large sky area; the row of ants is the clear subject.

timing.notes: The row is visible from the start of the shot, through 'derselben Strecke' (14.68).

content.notes: Question: how do they know where the bread is? (line 4)

action.notes: Crouches watching the ants, '?' pops up, the eyes turn toward the bread.

motion.notes: Fixed: both hands rest on the knees (previously one arm stuck up behind the head); seated pose stable.

composition.notes: Figure on the left, row of ants and bread small on the ground, '?' above.

timing.notes: '?' at 16.2 on 'Woher'; the gaze moves to the bread at 17.4–17.7 ('Brot').

content.notes: Concept: scent trail (Duftstraße) for species that use it, an illustrated line only.

action.notes: The dotted trail is drawn from the nest to the bread.

motion.notes: Draws continuously from the nest to the bread.

composition.notes: Fixed: the DUFTSTRASSE card moved to the top and no longer covers the bread.

timing.notes: The card and trail start at 19.4, on 'Duftstraßen'.

content.notes: Side view: the scout ant leaves pheromone dots on the way back, card PHEROMONE.

action.notes: Walks toward the nest, lowers its abdomen, and the trail of dots grows behind it.

motion.notes: The dots appear behind the abdomen and stay in place.

composition.notes: Ant large in the frame; card at the top.

timing.notes: The card and dots appear on 'Pheromone' (22.54).

content.notes: Following ants orient themselves along the dots, card CHEMISCHE SPUR.

action.notes: An ant walks along the dots; the antenna circle sweeps.

motion.notes: Body follows the trail steadily; the antenna circle moves with the head.

composition.notes: Close top-down view; the card is above the subtitle.

content.notes: The column follows the trail to the bread.

action.notes: Ants leave the nest along the dots and reach the bread; a ring around the bread.

motion.notes: Ants keep spacing along the route, no jumps.

composition.notes: Same geography as the earlier top-down shots.

timing.notes: The first ant reaches the bread and the ring appears at about 28.5, on 'Brot'.

content.notes: Side view: the ant bites a crumb and carries it away, card NAHRUNG.

action.notes: Bites, lifts the crumb with its mandibles, turns back.

motion.notes: The crumb stays at the mandibles while turning; the ant turns with a visible head turn.

composition.notes: Card at the top, ant and bread in the centre.

content.notes: Ants carrying crumbs back reinforce the trail, card MEHR DUFT.

action.notes: Ants with crumbs return; the trail line thickens.

motion.notes: Ants with crumbs move toward the nest and empty ants toward the bread; continuous.

composition.notes: Fixed: the card moved to the top and no longer covers the bread.

timing.notes: The trail thickens and the card appears on 'Duftmarkierung' (32.14).

content.notes: Two lanes: empty ants go out, ants with crumbs come back ('wiederholten Wege').

action.notes: Two lanes in opposite directions, continuous.

motion.notes: Fixed: larger ants, evenly spaced, each lane on its own dotted line.

composition.notes: Fixed: horizon moved up to y 720, the two lanes fill the middle of the frame.

content.notes: Nest ⇄ food route, labels NEST and FUTTER.

action.notes: Two-way column; the labels appear in turn.

motion.notes: Ants evenly spaced, no jumps.

composition.notes: Labels next to the nest and bread, clear of the subtitle.

timing.notes: NEST at 35.32, FUTTER at 36.0, matching 'Nest und Futter'.

content.notes: You take the bread away; the ants stay on the ground (line 9).

action.notes: Crouches, the left hand reaches, grips the bread's end, stands up and lifts it to the side; card WEG.

motion.notes: Fixed: grips with the near hand, the bread follows the hand, elbow points down; the ants stay on the ground and scatter slightly.

composition.notes: Same layout as scene 2 (nest, bread placement), the figure doesn't cover the bread.

content.notes: Ants already on the way keep walking along the old trail, card UNTERWEGS.

action.notes: The column moves toward the empty spot (dashed outline).

motion.notes: The column is dense but continuous; the trail stays.

composition.notes: Fixed: the card moved to the top, not overlapping the dashed outline.

content.notes: Close-up of the old spot, card ALTER PLATZ.

action.notes: Ants arrive, stop and wave their antennae inside the empty outline.

motion.notes: Ants stop at the outline and spread out; no jumps.

composition.notes: The dashed outline is the clear focal point.

content.notes: The scent remains, the bread is gone: DUFTSPUR + BROT, red X.

action.notes: Labels appear, X drawn over the bread spot.

motion.notes: The trail stays while ants keep coming.

composition.notes: Two labels on either side of the route, clear of the subtitle.

content.notes: The ants search around the spot (SUCHEN).

action.notes: They spread out in a spiral from the old spot.

motion.notes: Circling paths are smooth.

composition.notes: Centred, card at the top.

content.notes: Without reinforcement the trail fades, card NICHT VERSTÄRKT.

action.notes: The dots fade and thin out.

motion.notes: Fading is continuous, ants are still on the way.

composition.notes: Fixed: the card moved to the top, not covering the dashed outline.

content.notes: Fewer and fewer ants follow, card WENIGER.

action.notes: Ants drop out one by one; the trail fades further.

motion.notes: Ants fade out instead of jumping away.

composition.notes: Fixed: the card moved to the top.

timing.notes: The number drops visibly around 'weniger Ameisen' (56.48).

content.notes: Back to you watching the row of ants (line 13).

action.notes: Crouches watching the row walking past.

motion.notes: Fixed: hands on the knees (the old pose had an arm crossing the torso); the ants walk continuously.

composition.notes: Same figure, same style.

content.notes: Ants turn at the same spot (pebble), ABBIEGEN, reach the ZIEL.

action.notes: The column walks, turns at the pebble, reaches the goal.

motion.notes: The turn follows the trail, no shortcuts.

composition.notes: Pebble and goal clear, small labels.

content.notes: The ants have no map: map → red X, KEINE LANDKARTE.

action.notes: Map appears beside the ant, red X drawn over it.

motion.notes: The ant stands still; the X is drawn in.

composition.notes: Map large and clear, card at the top.

content.notes: Information on the ground under its feet: INFORMATION, AM BODEN.

action.notes: The ant walks; the dots under its feet light up.

motion.notes: Feet on the ground line, the glow follows the ant.

composition.notes: Two cards at the top, ant in the centre.

timing.notes: AM BODEN on 'Boden' (68.66); ends with the ant standing on the glowing trail.

hook.notes: Frame 0 has the headline BROT NEBEN AMEISEN?, the figure holding bread and the nest; the walk starts immediately and the first cut is at 2.6 s (hook.jpg).

continuity.notes: Top-down geography is constant (nest lower left, bread upper right, dashed outline once the bread is taken); scenes 2 and 18 now share the nest/bread position; the same orange-shirt figure throughout; the trail goes from forming → thicker → fading.

pacing.notes: 28 shots / 70.9 s ≈ 2.5 s per shot; side-on, top-down and close-up views alternate; each shot has its own action (find, check, return, reinforce, take away, search, fade).
